moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio e-bounce, written here): Target moves 0 → 100 % on bounce.out, 800 ms: contacts at 36 / 73 / 91 % of the time, rebounds 25 / 6 / 1.6 % high. Site rule: falls and landings. Squash on contact is a separate item (CustomBounce with Squash). Site demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.8 s) · ease (bounce.out).
